function.name: midh_check_eligibility
function.description: Checks eligibility for MIDH horticulture subsidy based on land ownership, crop suitability, category (general/SC-ST/women/hilly region), and prior subsidy history. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has existing MIDH subsidy for same land (duplicate), land records unavailable, or crop-region mismatch.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

function.name: midh_generate_otp
function.description: Sends OTP for MIDH authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.
